prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” broker for everyone — the right broker depends on what kind of coverage you need (individual/Family ACA plan, Medicare, small‑group/employer, short‑term, Medicaid/CHIP), whether you want in‑person help, and your ZIP code (Kansas City spans both Missouri and Kansas).

If you tell me:
- Which type of plan (individual/family ACA, Medicare, employer/small group, etc.)
- Your ZIP code
- Any preferences (in‑person vs virtual, Spanish or other language, independent broker vs agent tied to one carrier)

I’ll pull a short list of well‑reviewed, licensed brokers in your area and include contact info.

Meanwhile, quick guidance to find a good broker and questions to ask:
- Prefer an independent broker who represents multiple carriers (more choice).
- Verify they’re licensed in MO and/or KS at the state insurance department sites.
- Check reviews (Google, Yelp, BBB) and ask for local references.
- Confirm they help with enrollment, subsidies/Marketplace if needed, and claim issues after you enroll.
- Ask:
  - Which carriers and plans do you typically work with?
  - Do you charge fees, or are you paid by insurers?
  - Will you help with enrollments, renewals, and claims support?
  - How do you communicate (phone, email, in‑person) and what are your hours?
  - Can you provide references from recent clients?

If you want, give me your ZIP code and plan type now and I’ll find several qualified brokers in Kansas City and summarize differences so you can pick.
